items.title_zh: 2023 年最后发生的事情：第三部分
items.title_en: The Last Of What Happened Last Year In 2023: Part Three
items.summary_zh: 去年 2023 年发生了很多事情，这不是全部，但这是我最后一次讲述这些事情。您知道 Nabisco 威化饼已经有 100 岁了吗？现代 DNA 告诉我们有关路德维希·范·贝多芬晚年健康状况的一些我们所不知道的事情。 1827 年，他去世，享年 56 岁。
items.summary_en: There was so much that happened last year in 2023, and this isn’t all of it, but it’s the last about it from me. Did you know that Nabisco Wafers would have been 100 years old? Modern DNA told us things we didn’t know about Ludwig Van Beethoven’s health at the end of his life. He died in 1827 at a young 56 years old.

items.title_zh: 观看：哈迪普·辛格·普里与德里大学的老朋友重聚，视频融化了人们的心
items.title_en: Watch: Hardeep Singh Puri reunites with old friend from Delhi University, video melts hearts
items.summary_zh: 联邦部长哈迪普·辛格·普里 (Hardeep Singh Puri) 在 2024 年共和国峰会上与来自德里大学的老朋友 DU Raj Dutta Ji 重聚。他们重聚的温馨视频，回忆大学记忆，开玩笑年龄，最后以一个温暖的拥抱结束，很快在社交媒体上疯传。
items.summary_en: Union Minister Hardeep Singh Puri reunites with his old friend, DU Raj Dutta Ji, from Delhi University at the Republic Summit 2024. The heartwarming video of their reunion, reminiscing about college memories, joking about ages, and ending with a warm hug, quickly went viral on social media.

items.title_zh: 来自世界各地的更多奇怪饮料
items.title_en: More Strange Drinks From Around The World
items.summary_zh: 你读过《你知道这些来自世界各地的奇怪饮料吗？》这里有更多奇怪的饮料可以尝试！或不。蛇酒所以这种酒不是用蛇酿制的，而是用米酒浸泡蛇制成的。
items.summary_en: Have you read Do You Know About These Weird Drinks From Around The World? Here are more strange drinks to try! Or not. Snake Wine So this wine isn’t made from snakes but it is made from steeping a snake in rice wine.
